config.label: App Store Connect API Key ID
config.description: App Store Connect API Key ID. Normally written for you by `npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup`.

config.label: App Store Connect Issuer ID (a UUID)
config.description: App Store Connect Issuer ID (a UUID). Normally written for you by `setup`.

config.label: The
config.description: The .p8 private key as PEM text. Prefer `setup`, which stores it in the macOS Keychain instead of any config file; set this only where a Keychain is unavailable, such as CI.

config.label: Path to the
config.description: Path to the .p8 file, as an alternative to pasting its contents. Off macOS this is what `setup` records.

config.label: Bundle ID of one app
config.description: Bundle ID of one app. Only needed by the StoreKit 2 transaction tools on the monetization profile.
